desc: Parse input N and list S, compute max_val.
Build boolean presence array of size max_val+1, mark elements.
Recognize that naive double loop is O(max^2) and too slow.
Implement NTT (Number Theoretic Transform) convolution of binary array with itself modulo 998244353.
Pad array to next power of 2 ≥ 2*max_val+1.
Perform forward NTT on the padded array, square each element, then inverse NTT to get convolution.
For each B in S (from 1 to max_val), add (conv[2*B] - 1)//2 to ans.
Ensure integer arithmetic is used (mod 998244353) and handle division correctly (since conv[2B] is number of ordered pairs including (B,B), subtract 1 and divide by 2).
Test on sample inputs to verify answer matches.
Optimize NTT implementation for speed (e.g., iterative bit-reversal, precompute roots, or use complex FFT with rounding if NTT is too slow).
